+// the best ... I don't care about time"). grid=(G, B): G CTAs cooperate on ONE
+// matrix via a per-matrix sense-reversal barrier (the qr_panel_mcta pattern).
+// This fixes BOTH walls of the one-CTA qr_mega_n512: (1) OCCUPANCY -- the panel
+// is ROW-SPLIT across the G CTAs so each holds only ~pheight/G rows in smem
+// and (2) TRAILING PARALLELISM -- the G CTAs SPLIT the trailing col-tiles (each
+// owns whole col-tiles, reads all rows of V from the Vt buffer, chunks rows like
+// the two-level _trailing_fused_kernel), so one matrix's trailing is spread over
+// G CTAs instead of serialized in one. Fused into ONE launch: per outer block the
+// G CTAs cooperatively factor the panel, BARRIER, then cooperatively apply the
+// trailing, BARRIER (so the next block's panel sees the updated trailing). V/T go
+// through small per-matrix HBM buffers (Vt B*BLK*N, T B*BLK*BLK -- tiny, L2-hot).
+// Trailing GEMMs on TENSOR CORES (WMMA, PREC: 0=tf32x3, 3=fp16x3).
+    const float* __restrict__ Ain,   // (B, N, N) row-major source
+    float* __restrict__ Hout,        // (B, N, N) row-major dest
+    float* __restrict__ Vtbuf,       // (B, BLK, N) Vt[k, r] (per-matrix reflectors)
+    float* __restrict__ scr,         // (B, G, SCRW) panel reduction scratch
+    int strideVb, int strideVk, int strideVn,
+    int strideTb, int strideTk, int strideTn,
+    int BLK, int BM, int BNc, int G, int SCRW, int PREC)
+    const int g   = blockIdx.x;       // which CTA of this matrix (0..G-1)
+    // sPg: this CTA's panel ROW-SLICE (sliceHpad x BLK) col-major, ldm sliceHpad.
+    // sW row buffer (BLK) for the panel's tau*w[c]; sWpp (BLK) for w[c<k].
+    // For the trailing (chunked) we reuse a region: sAc (BM x BNc) + sVc (BLK x BM)
+    // + half staging. Lay everything out generously; the launcher sizes smem.
+    // (sliceHpad computed below; we lay trailing buffers AFTER the max panel slice)
+    // To keep pointers simple, the launcher passes a fixed PANEL_SLOTS (max slice
+    // rows padded) so the offsets are uniform across blocks.
+    // We instead recompute layout per-call using the WORST-case slice (block 0).
+    // Simpler: put trailing buffers at a fixed offset = SLICEMAXpad*BLK.
+    // SLICEMAXpad = ceil(ceil(N/G)/16)*16 (max rows any CTA holds, padded).
+    float* sW    = sbc + 4;                             // BLK (panel w buffer)
+    float* sWpp  = sW + BLK;                            // BLK (panel w[c<k])
+    // trailing chunk buffers (col-tile-split; chunked over rows):
+    float* sAc   = sWpp + BLK;                          // BM * BNc (A chunk, col-major ldm BM)
+    float* sWt   = sAc + (long)BM * BNc;                // BLK * BNc (W) col-major ldm BLK
+    float* sWtpp = sWt + (long)BLK * BNc;               // BLK * BNc (Wpp)
+    __half* sVch = (__half*)(sWtpp + (long)BLK * BNc);  // BLK * BM (V chunk hi) [HALF]
+    __half* sVcl = sVch + (long)BLK * BM;               // BLK * BM (V chunk lo) [THREE]
+    __half* sAch = sVcl + (long)BLK * BM;               // BM * BNc (A chunk hi) [HALF]
+    __half* sAcl = sAch + (long)BM * BNc;               // BM * BNc (A chunk lo) [THREE]
+    __half* sWtpph = sAcl + (long)BM * BNc;             // BLK * BNc (Wpp hi) [HALF]
+    __half* sWtppl = sWtpph + (long)BLK * BNc;          // BLK * BNc (Wpp lo) [THREE]
+        // this CTA's contiguous row slice [r0,r1) of the pheight-row panel.
+        int r0 = g * per; int r1 = r0 + per; if (r1 > pheight) r1 = pheight; if (r0 > pheight) r0 = pheight;
+        // ---- load this CTA's panel slice into sPg (col-major), pad rows>=sliceH to 0.
+        for (long idx = tid; idx < (long)sliceHpad * BLK; idx += nthr) {
+            int rr = idx % sliceHpad; int c = idx / sliceHpad;
+            if (rr < sliceH) v = src[(long)(j + r0 + rr) * strideAn + (j + c)];
+        // zero T (only g==0 writes T but all init for safety on g==0 path)
+        if (g == 0) for (int idx = tid; idx < BLK * BLK; idx += nthr) Tb[idx] = 0.0f;
+            // phase A: tail2 over THIS CTA's rows>k (global row j+r0+rr), to slot[0];
+            // alpha = col_k[k] published by the CTA owning row k to slot[1].
+            for (int rr = tid; rr < sliceH; rr += nthr) {
+                if (r > k) { float x = sPg[(long)k * sliceHpad + rr]; part += x * x; }
+            for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) part += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, part, off);
+            if (tid == 0) { float s = 0.f; for (int w2 = 0; w2 < WB; ++w2) s += sredw[w2]; myslot[0] = s; }
+            if (k >= r0 && k < r1 && tid == 0) myslot[1] = sPg[(long)k * sliceHpad + (k - r0)];
+            { float t2 = 0.f; for (int gg = 0; gg < G; ++gg) t2 += scr_mat[(long)gg * SCRW + 0];
+              int owner = k / per; if (owner >= G) owner = G - 1;
+            // (every thread recomputes tail2/alpha from scratch -- cheap, no smem bcast needed)
+            else { float normx = sqrtf(alpha*alpha + tail2); float sgn = (alpha>=0.f)?1.f:-1.f;
+            // write v into sPg col k: v[r>k]=col[r]*scale, v[k]=1 (owner).
+            for (int rr = tid; rr < sliceH; rr += nthr) {
+                if (r > k) sPg[(long)k * sliceHpad + rr] *= scale;
+                else if (r == k) sPg[(long)k * sliceHpad + rr] = 1.0f;
+                // phase B: w[c] = sum_{r>=k} v_k[r]*panel[r,c] over THIS CTA's rows, to slot[2+c].
+                for (int c = warp; c < BLK; c += WB) {
+                    for (int rr = lane; rr < sliceH; rr += 32) {
+                        if (r >= k) acc += sPg[(long)k * sliceHpad + rr] * sPg[(long)c * sliceHpad + rr];
+                    for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) acc += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, acc, off);
+                // sum partials -> w[c] (each thread recomputes for the cols it needs).
+                // apply to trailing cols c>k: panel[r,c]-=v[r]*tau*w[c] over THIS CTA's rows.
+                    float wc = 0.f; for (int gg = 0; gg < G; ++gg) wc += scr_mat[(long)gg * SCRW + 2 + c];
+                    for (int rr = tid; rr < sliceH; rr += nthr) {
+                        if (r >= k) sPg[(long)c * sliceHpad + rr] -= sPg[(long)k * sliceHpad + rr] * wc;
+                // g==0 builds T column k: T[a<k,k] = -tau_k*sum_{c<k} T[a,c]*w[c]; T[k,k]=tau_k.
+                    for (int a = tid; a < BLK; a += nthr) {
+                                float wc = 0.f; for (int gg = 0; gg < G; ++gg) wc += scr_mat[(long)gg * SCRW + 2 + c];
+                if (g == 0) for (int a = tid; a < BLK; a += nthr) Tb[(long)a * strideTk + (long)k * strideTn] = 0.0f;
+            // finalize col k diag: beta/alpha; tau (g==0).
+            if (k >= r0 && k < r1 && tid == 0) sPg[(long)k * sliceHpad + (k - r0)] = (tail2 == 0.0f) ? alpha : beta;
+        // ---- write panel slice (R+V) to H, and Vt[k, r] to Vtbuf (this CTA's rows) ----
+        for (long idx = tid; idx < (long)sliceH * BLK; idx += nthr) {
+            int rr = idx % sliceH; int c = idx / sliceH; int r = r0 + rr;
+            Hb[(long)(j + r) * strideAn + (j + c)] = sPg[(long)c * sliceHpad + rr];
+        // Vt[c, r_rel] (relative panel row r) = 1 if r==c, sPg if r>c, else 0.
+        for (long idx = tid; idx < (long)sliceH * BLK; idx += nthr) {
+            int rr = idx % sliceH; int c = idx / sliceH; int r = r0 + rr;
+            if (r == c) val = 1.0f; else if (r > c) val = sPg[(long)c * sliceHpad + rr]; else val = 0.0f;
+        COOP_BARRIER();   // panel V/T fully published before the trailing reads them
+        // ---- cooperative trailing: G CTAs SPLIT the col-tiles of [j+BLK, N). ----
+        // Each CTA owns whole col-tiles (col_tile % G == g), chunks rows over BM,
+        // reads V from Vtbuf (all rows), keeps W/YT in regs (smem here), tf32x3/fp16x3
+        // WMMA. A read from src, written to H. (V is relative-row in Vtbuf: Vt[k,r].)
+        const int PHpadT = ((pheight + 15) / 16) * 16;   // pad over rows for K-tiles
+        for (int ct = g; ct < n_ctiles; ct += G) {
+            // sweep 1: W = V^T @ A_trail over all pheight rows in BM chunks.
+            for (int idx = tid; idx < BLK * BNc; idx += nthr) sWt[idx] = 0.0f;
+                // load A chunk (BM x BNc) col-major sAc[rr + c*BM]; V chunk (BLK x BM) from Vt.
+                for (long idx = tid; idx < (long)BM * BNc; idx += nthr) {
+                    int rr = idx % BM; int c = idx / BM; int r = rb + rr; int gc = c0 + c;
+                    float v = (r < pheight && gc < ncols) ? src[(long)(j + r) * strideAn + (jt + gc)] : 0.0f;
+                    if (HALF) { __half hi, lo; f2h2(v, hi, lo); sAch[idx]=hi; if (THREE) sAcl[idx]=lo; }
+                // V chunk: Vch[k, rr] = Vt[k, rb+rr] (relative row). col-major (k fast)? store
+                // sVch[k + rr*BLK]? We need V^T[k,r] row_major (k,r) ldm=BM for the W=V^T@A frag.
+                // Lay sVc as (BLK x BM) ROW-major over (k,rr): sVc[k*BM + rr]. For tf32 we keep
+                // a float copy sVcf reusing sAc tail? To keep it simple: for tf32 read Vt directly
+                // into frags (global), for fp16 stage halves in smem.
+                for (long idx = tid; idx < (long)BLK * BM; idx += nthr) {
+                    int k2 = idx / BM; int rr = idx % BM; int r = rb + rr;
+                    float v = (r < pheight) ? Vb[(long)k2 * strideVk + (long)r * strideVn] : 0.0f;
+                    if (HALF) { __half hi, lo; f2h2(v, hi, lo); sVch[(long)k2 * BM + rr]=hi; if (THREE) sVcl[(long)k2 * BM + rr]=lo; }
+                    else sWtpp[0] = sWtpp[0];  // placeholder; tf32 path loads Vt from global below
+                    for (int tile = warp; tile < mt*nt; tile += WB) {
+                        MFragAcc acc; wmma::load_matrix_sync(acc, sWt + (long)mi*16 + (long)ni*16*BLK, BLK, wmma::mem_col_major);
+                            // V^T[k,r] row_major: Vb + mi*16*strideVk + (rb+kk*8)*strideVn, ldm strideVk
+                            MFragAR a; wmma::load_matrix_sync(a, Vb + (long)mi*16*strideVk + (long)(rb + kk*8)*strideVn, strideVk);
+                            MFragAR ah, al; MFragBC bh, bl;
+                            wmma::mma_sync(acc, ah, bh, acc); wmma::mma_sync(acc, ah, bl, acc); wmma::mma_sync(acc, al, bh, acc);
+                    for (int tile = warp; tile < mt*nt; tile += WB) {
+                        HFragAcc acc; wmma::load_matrix_sync(acc, sWt + (long)mi*16 + (long)ni*16*BLK, BLK, wmma::mem_col_major);
+            // YT = T^T @ W -> store negated into sWtpp (so sweep2 adds): Wpp[i,g] = -sum_l T[l,i] W[l,g]
+            for (int idx = tid; idx < BLK * BNc; idx += nthr) {
+                int gg = idx / BLK, i = idx % BLK;
+                for (int l = 0; l <= i; ++l) a += Tb[(long)l * strideTk + (long)i * strideTn] * sWt[(long)l + (long)gg * BLK];
+                if (HALF) { __half hi, lo; f2h2(wpp, hi, lo); sWtpph[(long)i + (long)gg*BLK]=hi; if (THREE) sWtppl[(long)i + (long)gg*BLK]=lo; }
+            // sweep 2: A_trail += V @ Wpp over BM row chunks (== A - V@YT). store to H.
+                // load A chunk again (col-major) + V chunk; acc preloaded from A.
+                for (long idx = tid; idx < (long)BM * BNc; idx += nthr) {
+                    int rr = idx % BM; int c = idx / BM; int r = rb + rr; int gc = c0 + c;
+                    float v = (r < pheight && gc < ncols) ? src[(long)(j + r) * strideAn + (jt + gc)] : 0.0f;
+                if (HALF) for (long idx = tid; idx < (long)BLK * BM; idx += nthr) {
+                    int k2 = idx / BM; int rr = idx % BM; int r = rb + rr;
+                    float v = (r < pheight) ? Vb[(long)k2 * strideVk + (long)r * strideVn] : 0.0f;
+                    __half hi, lo; f2h2(v, hi, lo); sVch[(long)k2 * BM + rr]=hi; if (THREE) sVcl[(long)k2 * BM + rr]=lo;
+                    for (int tile = warp; tile < mt*nt; tile += WB) {

+                            // V col-major (r,k): Vb + (rb+mi*16)*strideVn + kb*strideVk, ldm strideVk

+                            HFragBC wh; wmma::load_matrix_sync(wh, sWtpph + kb + (long)ni*16*BLK, BLK);

+                for (long idx = tid; idx < (long)BM * BNc; idx += nthr) {

    def launch_mega_coop(self, A, H, tau, Vt, T, scr, bar_cnt, bar_sense,
                         B, N, BLK, BM, BNc, G, nthreads, prec):
        # brief-56 COOPERATIVE CUDA megakernel: grid=(G, B). G CTAs cooperate on
        # one matrix (row-split panel + col-tile-split trailing) via the per-matrix
        # barrier. prec 0=tf32x3, 3=fp16x3.
        import numpy as np
        cd = self.cd
        WB = nthreads // 32
        SCRW = scr.shape[2]
        per0 = (N + G - 1) // G
        SLICEMAXpad = ((per0 + 15) // 16) * 16
        # fp32 smem floats: sPg(SLICEMAXpad*BLK) + sredw(WB) + sbc(4) + sW(BLK)
        #   + sWpp(BLK) + sAc(BM*BNc) + sWt(BLK*BNc) + sWtpp(BLK*BNc)
        f32 = (SLICEMAXpad * BLK + WB + 4 + BLK + BLK + BM * BNc + BLK * BNc + BLK * BNc)
        smem_bytes = f32 * 4
        if prec >= 1:
            # half: sVch(BLK*BM)+sVcl(BLK*BM)+sAch(BM*BNc)+sAcl(BM*BNc)+sWtpph(BLK*BNc)+sWtppl(BLK*BNc)
            smem_bytes += (BLK * BM + BLK * BM + BM * BNc + BM * BNc + BLK * BNc + BLK * BNc) * 2
        sAb, sAn = A.stride(0), A.stride(1)
        a = [
            np.array([A.data_ptr()], dtype=np.uint64),
            np.array([H.data_ptr()], dtype=np.uint64),
            np.array([tau.data_ptr()], dtype=np.uint64),
            np.array([Vt.data_ptr()], dtype=np.uint64),
            np.array([T.data_ptr()], dtype=np.uint64),
            np.array([scr.data_ptr()], dtype=np.uint64),
            np.array([bar_cnt.data_ptr()], dtype=np.uint64),
            np.array([bar_sense.data_ptr()], dtype=np.uint64),
            np.array([B], dtype=np.int32), np.array([N], dtype=np.int32),
            np.array([sAb], dtype=np.int32), np.array([sAn], dtype=np.int32),
            np.array([Vt.stride(0)], dtype=np.int32), np.array([Vt.stride(1)], dtype=np.int32), np.array([Vt.stride(2)], dtype=np.int32),
            np.array([T.stride(0)], dtype=np.int32), np.array([T.stride(1)], dtype=np.int32), np.array([T.stride(2)], dtype=np.int32),
            np.array([BLK], dtype=np.int32), np.array([BM], dtype=np.int32), np.array([BNc], dtype=np.int32),

    def launch_tc_wt(self, A, Vbuf, WT, B, NC, P, BK):
        # WT[b] = (Vbuf[b] @ A_trail[b])^T. A is the trailing block base (B, P, NC);
        # Vbuf[b] is V^T (BLK x P); WT is (B, NC, BLK=32). grid=(col_tiles, B).
        import numpy as np
        cd = self.cd
        BM = 128
        ntile = (NC + BM - 1) // BM
        smem = (BM * BK + 32 * BK) * 2 + 1024
        sab, san = A.stride(0), A.stride(1)
        svb, svk, svn = Vbuf.stride(0), Vbuf.stride(1), Vbuf.stride(2)
        swb, swc = WT.stride(0), WT.stride(1)
        a = [np.array([A.data_ptr()], dtype=np.uint64),
             np.array([Vbuf.data_ptr()], dtype=np.uint64),
             np.array([WT.data_ptr()], dtype=np.uint64),
             np.array([B], dtype=np.int32), np.array([NC], dtype=np.int32),
             np.array([P], dtype=np.int32), np.array([BK], dtype=np.int32),
             np.array([sab], dtype=np.int64), np.array([san], dtype=np.int64),
             np.array([svb], dtype=np.int64), np.array([svk], dtype=np.int64),
             np.array([svn], dtype=np.int64),
             np.array([swb], dtype=np.int64), np.array([swc], dtype=np.int64)]
        argv = np.array([x.ctypes.data for x in a], dtype=np.uint64)
        cur = getattr(torch.cuda, self._cur_q)()
        qh = getattr(cur, self._cuda_q)
        err, = cd.cuLaunchKernel(
            self.func_tc_wt, ntile, B, 1, 128, 1, 1,

def _tcgen05_wt_selftest(verbose=True):
    # Validate the tcgen05 W^T mainloop on n512-realistic shapes vs a torch
    # reference (Vbuf @ A)^T. Returns max relative error (~fp16 rounding == PASS).
    kern = _get_kernel()
    B, BLK, P, NC, BK = 3, 32, 512, 256, 64
    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(2)
    A = torch.randn(B, P, NC, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32, generator=g)
    Vbuf = torch.randn(B, BLK, P, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32, generator=g)
    WT = torch.zeros(B, NC, BLK, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
    kern.launch_tc_wt(A, Vbuf, WT, B, NC, P, BK)
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    ref = torch.bmm(Vbuf, A).transpose(1, 2)   # (B, NC, BLK)
    err = (WT - ref).abs().max().item()
    rel = err / (ref.abs().max().item() + 1e-6)
    if verbose:
        print(f"[tcgen05_wt_selftest] B={B} BLK={BLK} P={P} NC={NC} BK={BK} "
              f"max_abs_err={err:.4f} rel={rel:.5f} {'PASS' if rel < 0.02 else 'FAIL'}")
    return rel


def _tcgen05_selftest(verbose=True):
    # Feasibility gate: prove the tcgen05 stack (alloc/mma/commit/ld/dealloc) runs
    # correctly on THIS box before any trailing kernel relies on it. Returns the
    # max-abs error vs an fp16-reference matmul; ~fp16 rounding (<0.05) == PASS.
    kern = _get_kernel()
    M, N, K = 128, 64, 16
    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(0)
    A = torch.randn(M, K, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32, generator=g)
    B = torch.randn(N, K, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32, generator=g)
    C = torch.zeros(M, N, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
    kern.launch_tc_selftest(A, B, C, M, N, K)
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    ref = A @ B.T
    err = (C - ref).abs().max().item()
    if verbose:
        print(f"[tcgen05_selftest] M={M} N={N} K={K} max_abs_err={err:.6f} "
              f"{'PASS' if err < 0.05 else 'FAIL'}")
    return err

def _get_kernel():
    global _KERNEL
    if _KERNEL is None:
        _KERNEL = _SmallQRKernel()
    return _KERNEL


def _tcgen05_selftest(verbose=True):
    # Feasibility gate: prove the tcgen05 stack (alloc/mma/commit/ld/dealloc) runs
    # correctly on THIS box before any trailing kernel relies on it. Returns the
    # max-abs error vs an fp16-reference matmul; ~fp16 rounding (<0.05) == PASS.
    kern = _get_kernel()
    M, N, K = 128, 64, 16
    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(0)
    A = torch.randn(M, K, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32, generator=g)
    B = torch.randn(N, K, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32, generator=g)
    C = torch.zeros(M, N, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
    kern.launch_tc_selftest(A, B, C, M, N, K)
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    ref = A @ B.T
    err = (C - ref).abs().max().item()
    if verbose:
        print(f"[tcgen05_selftest] M={M} N={N} K={K} max_abs_err={err:.6f} "
              f"{'PASS' if err < 0.05 else 'FAIL'}")
    return err


def _tcgen05_wt_selftest(verbose=True, B=3, BLK=32, P=512, NC=256, BK=64):
    # Validate the tcgen05 W^T mainloop vs a torch reference (Vbuf @ A)^T.
    # Returns max relative error (~fp16 rounding == PASS).
    kern = _get_kernel()
    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(2)
    A = torch.randn(B, P, NC, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32, generator=g)
    Vbuf = torch.randn(B, BLK, P, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32, generator=g)
    WT = torch.zeros(B, NC, BLK, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
    kern.launch_tc_wt(A, Vbuf, WT, B, NC, P, BK)
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    ref = torch.bmm(Vbuf, A).transpose(1, 2)   # (B, NC, BLK)
    err = (WT - ref).abs().max().item()
    rel = err / (ref.abs().max().item() + 1e-6)
    if verbose:
        print(f"[tcgen05_wt_selftest] B={B} BLK={BLK} P={P} NC={NC} BK={BK} "
              f"max_abs_err={err:.4f} rel={rel:.5f} {'PASS' if rel < 0.02 else 'FAIL'}")
    return rel
